content:
For the perk found in Nuclear Winter, see Nuclear Winter perks.

“What are you, part pack mule?”

**Strong Back** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increased Carry capacity based on the Strength.

| ![FO76 strong back perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/5/5f/FO76_strong_back_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Strength | Carry Weight | 
| | 1 | +10 | 
| | 15 | +40 | 
| | 30 | +65 | 
| | 60 | +85 | 
| | 100 | +100 | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | Gain more carry weight based on your STR. | 0004B24E | 

- Before Update 58 Strong Back provided a flat +10/+20/+30/+40 carry capacity.

Other perks that scale with Strength include:

- Barbarian - more Damage Resistance
